cohort: The study included 120 ASA class 1 and 2 patients randomly allocated into three groups, all scheduled for cesarean section.
finding: Applying PEEP (5 and 10 cmH2O) during cesarean section significantly increased mean oxygen saturation in the Post-Anesthesia Care Unit (PACU) compared to the control group (0 cmH2O PEEP), with 5 cmH2O PEEP being more efficient.
